title: Under Patagonian Spires: Where Pumas, Sheep Herding and Fine Dining Collide
summary_full: Estancia Cerro Guido, a Chilean ranch that swapped puma bounties for conservation tours, offers travelers luxury experiences on the edge of the wilderness.
